summary: Texas climbing coach Austin Wolff and local partner Susan Katz benighted on the First Flatiron after struggling to build anchors; the pair set out around 3:30 p.m. with Wolff's two-year-old cat Link in a backpack and ended up in total darkness without proper descent gear. Rocky Mountain Rescue Group received the Saturday-night call, provided headlamps and lowered all three to safety on belay; all unharmed but cold. The cat reportedly slept through the ordeal.
notes: Date-inference: advnture.com article published ~2024-04-05 says RMRG received 'the call Saturday night' and the callout happened 'last week' → Saturday 2024-03-30 (verified Saturday). Resolves the run-219 pending lead (cat Link, RMRG).
